text:
Olivia Park: Heads-up — Onramp Labs wants a 72h migration POC to validate compatibility with their existing vendor. They care about stream framing, header passthrough, stop-token semantics, and a short pricing bridge.
Marcus Holt: What exact endpoints do they call today?
Olivia Park: POST /api/v1/generate (uses chunked transfer encoding), custom header X-Customer-Context, and strict stop-token handling. They also surface model name in X-Model-Version.
Neha Srinivasan: We can proxy and normalize. Proposal: lightweight adaptor that maps /api/v1/generate -> /redwood/stream, copies X-Customer-Context into metadata, and emits chunks matching their original boundaries.
Ibrahim Sadiq: Quick Go shim sketch to replicate chunking and header mapping:
```go
http.HandleFunc("/api/v1/generate", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request){
  meta := r.Header.Get("X-Customer-Context")
  // call Redwood streaming API (pseudocode)
  stream := redwood.Stream(r.Body, meta)
  w.Header().Set("Content-Type","application/octet-stream")
  for chunk := range stream {
    // write with same chunk framing
    w.Write([]byte(chunk.Frame))
    w.(http.Flusher).Flush()
  }
})
```
Marcus Holt: Good. Two engineering caveats: 1) tokenization differences for HTML inputs, 2) stop-token edge cases when clients rely on exact delimiter emission.
Neha Srinivasan: I'll run a 400-sample parity run focusing on HTML-containing prompts and stop-token edge-cases. Flagging any >2-token variance or missing stop emission.
Olivia Park: Security questionnaire highlights: HSM key import, SOC2 + ISO27001 proof, customer-managed key wrap for cache, and a subprocessors list.
sec-bot: Auto-reply: "HSM import available on Dedicated/Private. SOC2 and ISO27001 reports available via legal portal. Customer key wrap supported; see internal docs: https://internal.redwood/security/kms."
Marcus Holt: Performance ask: Onramp requires p95 < 250ms for 256 tokens. Hosted usually meets this but p99 spikes on burst. Recommend a 48-72h Dedicated smoke window to demonstrate stability.
Ibrahim Sadiq: Ops tests to run in Dedicated window:
- 250 concurrent short requests (<=32 tokens) measure p99
- 80 simultaneous streaming clients for 15s
- parity harness run against their corpus
Neha Srinivasan: Early parity run results (partial): 400 prompts -> 320 exact semantic parity, 52 formatting-only diffs, 28 stop-token mismatches. Uploading full diff to shared doc. Link: https://docs.redwood/onramp-parity-1763219876
Marcus Holt: Stop-token mismatches likely a truncation/stream-flush sequencing issue. We can add deterministic flush on stop-token emission in the shim to reduce diffs.
Olivia Park: Commercial ask from Onramp: price-match host rate for first 30 days + migration credit. Sales propose 25% off hosted for 30 days + $7k migration credit if they sign Dedicated LOI within 90 days. POC cap: $1,500.
sales-bot: Logged proposal: 25% discount (30d), migration credit $7,000, POC cap $1,500.
Marcus Holt: Logistics: Need SRE window and billing sign-off. Also legal will want DPA addendum for key residency.
sec-bot: Note: For HSM imports we need a 5-business-day lead time for key onboarding when Dedicated/Private is selected.
Olivia Park: Timeline: Onramp expects results in 6 business days. Doable if we start the shim + parity runs tomorrow and get fast approvals.
Neha Srinivasan: Action items:
- Neha: finish parity diffs and attach representative failing prompts (due 1763240000).
- Ibrahim: prepare shim repo + Dedicated smoke window request (SRE) and canary fallback plan.
- Marcus: draft commercial note + SOW template with POC cap and migration credit.
- sec-bot: collate security checklist answers and attach SOC2/ISO references before kickoff.
Ibrahim Sadiq: I'll add an HTML-normalizer middleware to the shim and a deterministic stop-token flush to reduce the 28 mismatches.
Marcus Holt: Finance: please confirm migration credit and discount OK. Tagging @finance (cc Olivia).
sales-bot: Meeting created: Onramp Labs POC Kickoff — Tomorrow 09:30 PT — https://cal.redwood/onramp-poc-1763219876
Olivia Park: Any objections to offering the proposed commercial bridge (25% + $7k credit) if finance signs off?
Marcus Holt: No technical objections.
sec-bot: Security ok with terms provided HSM restricted to Dedicated/Private and lead time noted.
Ibrahim Sadiq: Ops ok pending SRE window.
Neha Srinivasan: I'll prioritize parity fixes for HTML and stop-tokens.
Olivia Park: Great — I'll send the invite and attach the parity doc. If approvals slip, flag immediately and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
